Description.description: wbs:4.6 (CO-004), TAD docs/architecture/postcode-lookup-architecture.md S3/S13. How rev_localauthorityregister.rev_resolutionstatus classifies one outward code. Resolved = a single local authority holds the modal share required by the seeded LocalAuthorityRegisterMultiAuthorityThresholdPercent setting (ADR-004/S13); Multi-Authority = a second authority holds at least that share (S13, reviewer decision 2026-09-23: 5%); NI Pending Licence = every BT-prefixed outward code, name join deliberately skipped (FR-203); Out of UK LA Scope = the two ONSPD pseudo-codes M99999999 (Isle of Man) / L99999999 (Channel Islands), neither a UK local authority (S3, Revision 2, new). Every value other than Resolved carries a null rev_localauthorityname (ADR-003).
